headline: US and Canada Trade Negotiations Stall Over Proposed 25% Auto Tariffs
summary: Bilateral trade talks between Canada and the United States remain unresolved, with Canadian officials seeing minimal progress on US tariff relief ahead of a scheduled increase in auto import duties to 50% in January.
why: Cross-border trade agreements between North American trade partners regulate billions of dollars in automotive and industrial shipments, impacting regional automotive manufacturers and currency flows.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Higher tariffs threaten cross-border automotive supply chains and industrial output.
